points.description: The final answer is exactly the open interval (2, ∞): all real numbers greater than 2, with 2 itself excluded. Equivalent notation such as {x : x > 2} is accepted. Every step must be mathematically valid, as the model answer requires.

rubric.notes: This is a single-idea, one-mark question, so one all-or-nothing point is used. Full marks require the correct set (2, ∞) with valid reasoning throughout. Any wrong step or wrong final set (for example [2, ∞), or a bounded set) earns no marks. Partial credit is not applicable.
